quests.title: 界石与两家的余账
quests.brief: 蓝阿鲤核实过调停后的潮界，愿同你把渔户实际收到的补贴和留下的差额再讲清。先前调停没有抹掉每一笔分歧。

objectives.description: 逐户核对这一笔补贴

choices.title: 逐户核对这一笔补贴
choices.description: 在白鹭村找实际收款的渔户，对照同一次调停的数额，不接触钱庄无关私账。
choices.success: 收款人与欠项被分别记清，原来被算成一笔的搬桩工钱得到澄清。蓝阿鲤可以据此继续交涉；钱庄是否补付仍需另谈。
choices.failure: 收款人口述彼此矛盾，眼下只能保留两种说法，没有替任何人补造签名。
choices.success_echo: 这笔差额已有具体出处，不再当作整村受骗的传闻。愿否继续交涉由当事人决定。
choices.failure_echo: 已知的缺口仍待核实；可以补足准备或暂时放下，不再凭空追加报酬或追兵。

quests.title: 新沟的回流标记
quests.brief: 蓝阿鲤核实过几趟试网，发现新沟可用，却有一股回流会拖偏浅船。她愿商量把标记补到渔户看得见的地方。

objectives.description: 给回流补两处岸标

choices.title: 给回流补两处岸标
choices.description: 在已经开通的新沟旁量两处可见岸标，按真实舟楫功夫作业；不再撬一次巨石或领取旧谢礼。
choices.success: 你们把标记落在低潮仍能看见的两处石面。新沟可以继续试用，但风浪大时仍需停船。
choices.failure: 回流比估计急，标记未能落稳，只留下暂缓行船的提醒。
choices.success_echo: 回访时能认出这两处标记；新沟的使用仍随实际风浪，不会永久保证满网鱼获。
choices.failure_echo: 已知的缺口仍待核实；可以补足准备或暂时放下，不再凭空追加报酬或追兵。

quests.title: 先把旧潮线说清
quests.brief: 调停未成后，蓝阿鲤愿从可查的旧潮线重新谈起。她不要求你替钱庄担保，也不许诺查清后两边必定和好。

objectives.description: 比较桩脚与退潮泥线

choices.title: 比较桩脚与退潮泥线
choices.description: 留在白鹭村核对旧桩脚和退潮泥线，把亲见与村民转述分开。
choices.success: 旧桩不是一夜全移：最靠里的一根沿腐烂桩孔倾倒，另外两根仍有新挖痕。争执终于有了可以逐项核查的范围。
choices.failure: 水迹尚未退净，无法区分旧孔与新坑；你没有替任何一方确认全部说法。
choices.success_echo: 可以就两处新坑继续询问，也可先修复倒桩；一次查验没有替双方达成新的契约。
choices.failure_echo: 已知的缺口仍待核实；可以补足准备或暂时放下，不再凭空追加报酬或追兵。

quests.title: 比潮水早到的灯
quests.brief: 青盐滩的船户发现望潮崖风灯总比真实退潮早亮一刻。旧潮牌仍在，谁也不肯只凭传言夜航。先看泥线，再核崖上的计时来由，最后决定怎样处理这一次误差。

objectives.description: 在青盐滩取得这次潮线的实际记录。
到望潮崖核对更夫计时与现场痕迹。
在望潮崖选择修正灯号或留下安全绕行说明。

choices.title: 带绳下滩量水
choices.description: 用自己的舟楫本领与带钩麻绳测潮痕，实际耗费6点内力。
choices.success: 水退到旧标后，礁口仍有侧流；你留下两个不受浪花误导的泥线标记。
choices.failure: 侧流使绳端无法稳定，尚不能据此决定夜航。
choices.success_echo: 量过的两处潮痕可供这次对照，季节变化后仍需重测。
choices.failure_echo: 这次未能办妥的问题仍在；付出的时间和材料不会返还。可以补足准备、改走其他办法，或暂不继续。

choices.title: 付工钱，随本地船户等一趟潮
choices.description: 付80铜钱请船户说明旧标，自己在岸上守候三小时并记下实际退水；这是一次有边界的带看，不获得舟楫功夫。
choices.success: 你亲眼记下退水先后：旧刻线比可安全靠礁的水位早了一段，船户的抱怨有实证。
choices.failure: 岸边浪花遮住了关键刻线，尚未得到可信的比较。
choices.success_echo: 这次带看已经付费，不重复领取同一份观潮记录。
choices.failure_echo: 这次未能办妥的问题仍在；付出的时间和材料不会返还。可以补足准备、改走其他办法，或暂不继续。

choices.title: 对照漏壶与旧潮牌
choices.description: 带着已取得的潮线记录，在望潮崖请当值更夫核对漏壶，检查塞口与最近的换班记号。
choices.success: 新换的漏壶塞口比旧件松，出水偏快；更夫仍照原刻度点灯。潮线、漏水与换班日期能相互对上，这次误差并非有人故意引船触礁。
choices.failure: 更夫拿不出换班记号，漏壶也尚未测够，不能把猜想当成查明。
choices.success_echo: 查清的是这盏灯的计时误差，不是海口所有传闻。
choices.failure_echo: 这次未能办妥的问题仍在；付出的时间和材料不会返还。可以补足准备、改走其他办法，或暂不继续。

choices.title: 自己修塞，重校刻度
choices.description: 用一份锻兵生铁修正塞件，凭已学锻打养兵术校准，实际耗费6点内力；这里只修这一盏灯。
choices.success: 塞件装妥后，漏壶与实测潮线在这轮核对中相合。更夫接过新的校时记号，答应按它检查，不许诺从此永不失准。
choices.failure: 塞件仍渗漏，已用材料不能收回；灯旁保留暂缓夜航的说明。
choices.success_echo: 这盏灯留下了可查的修理与校时记录。它没有刷新成一桩新悬案。
choices.failure_echo: 这次未能办妥的问题仍在；付出的时间和材料不会返还。可以补足准备、改走其他办法，或暂不继续。

choices.title: 留警戒牌，请船户走已知岸线
choices.description: 付40铜钱给当值灯户备牌，把已查明的早灯误差写明；不拆漏壶，不假称维修完成。
choices.success: 警戒牌写清灯早与礁口侧流，来船可选择白日岸线；漏壶仍待原灯户另行维修。
choices.failure: 牌面未能固定，暂不能当作船户已经看到提醒。
choices.success_echo: 这次以告知与绕行收束，没有获得修理完工的钱，也不必继续卷入。
choices.failure_echo: 这次未能办妥的问题仍在；付出的时间和材料不会返还。可以补足准备、改走其他办法，或暂不继续。

quests.title: 去鹤渡镇认一认路
quests.brief: 葛长篙请正式入帮的成员从浮萍坞走一趟鹤渡镇，认清帮中往来的这一段路。这次只约定实际到镇上，不把到场算成巡查无事，也不要求替任何人作保。

objectives.description: 接受约定后，本人实际抵达鹤渡镇。

realms.theme: 潮信渡滩头的一艘搁浅旧舟，舷边缆索吃紧；外缘仍有可用药草，深处的船体支撑则关乎退潮后的侧舱通路。

objectives.description: 带走外缘可用材料。
拆取核心的可用材料。
在受挫后收回有限残余。
取走回访侧路的有限旧存料。

areas.name: 潮信渡搁浅旧舟
areas.description: 潮信渡滩头的一艘搁浅旧舟，舷边缆索吃紧；外缘仍有可用药草，深处的船体支撑则关乎退潮后的侧舱通路。

areas.name: 承力底舱
areas.description: 底舱的绳路与铁件共同撑住船身，维持支撑与拆取铁件不能兼得。

areas.name: 落潮侧舱
areas.description: 落潮后才能从保全的绳路进入的小侧舱，留下的是一批有限的旧船存物。舱外可接高岸旧纤道，绕过潮信渡至白鹭村的一段泥滩；高岸路不依赖潮水一直退着。

approaches.name: 察看吃水和受力
approaches.description: 观察船身吃水与舷板受力，找出普通人也能走的外舷绕路。

discoveries.text: 吃水与舷板受力表明可以贴着外舷绕过倾斜船架。

approaches.name: 贴外舷慢绕
approaches.description: 循已看清的受力位置绕行，不耗内力，也不用专门工具。

approaches.name: 系绳固定穿行
approaches.description: 持有三爪带钩生麻绳即可固定穿行，不消耗绳，也不凭空消耗内力。

approaches.name: 借舟楫水战过舷
approaches.description: 使用已学舟楫水战，消耗该招式真实内力，借水势完整通过。

approaches.name: 强拆船架
approaches.description: 花较少时间强拆船架，能进底舱，但会破坏船体支撑。

discoveries.text: 强拆船架已折损支撑，不能再保持完整绳路。

approaches.name: 收取舷边药草
approaches.description: 取一份舷边干燥药草即可离开；停留会进一步吃掉船体余地。

approaches.name: 保全支撑绳路
approaches.description: 维持船体支撑而不取铁件；六小时后落潮会露出侧舱通路。

discoveries.text: 船体支撑与绳路已保住，六小时后可检查落潮侧舱。

approaches.name: 拆取旧舟铁件
approaches.description: 拆下两份可用铁件，放弃完整支撑与落潮侧舱的机会。

discoveries.text: 此处可回收的核心所得已取走。

approaches.name: 回收散落铁件
approaches.description: 在滩头安全处收回一份散落铁件，不再深入失稳的船身。

approaches.name: 探看落潮侧路
approaches.description: 沿保全的绳路检查已经退去的潮水，找到可走的侧舱入口。

discoveries.text: 落潮露出了侧舱通路，可以沿保住的绳路进出。

approaches.name: 取走侧舱药草
approaches.description: 带走两份侧舱旧存药草；已取走的船货不会重新出现。

discoveries.text: 此处可回收的核心所得已取走。

approaches.name: 按商定借力点沿舷挪位
approaches.description: 按共同商定的借力和退身次序，自己沿舷挪位；不额外牵动船架。

events.title: 潮信渡的松扣
events.brief: 潮信渡到白鹭渔村仍可走十二小时旱路。想随船走，先看看渡头木牌。

participants.name: 宋老橹
participants.public_role: 老渡公，在渡头贴出当天能走的水路。

stages.title: 涨水前
stages.summary: 渡头木牌写着：下次涨水前，短渡须重新校准。宋老橹站在潮尺旁，正等人来帮忙对照石碑水线。
participant_lines: 你和宋老橹对上石碑水线，压紧滑落的拴扣。他记下短渡水线，答应凭这次校准带你走十小时短渡，涨水以后也认这道记号。

stages.title: 涨水后
stages.summary: 渡头换了木牌：短渡只走涨水前校过的水线。错过校准的客人可找宋老橹复核外汊，或走原来的旱路。木牌上没有写潮尺出了什么问题。
participant_lines: 宋老橹指给你看滑落的拴扣。旧刻痕已没在水下，你们到外桩复核水线，只能确认十一小时的外汊水路。

actions.label: 找宋老橹校准潮尺
actions.brief: 对照石碑与潮尺，确认十小时短渡。涨水前校准后，涨水前后都能出发。

actions.label: 找宋老橹复核外汊
actions.brief: 错过了短渡校准，复核后可走十一小时外汊水路。

cooperation_projects.Name: 辨清借力点
cooperation_projects.Description: 请在场且愿意的船工协助研判，准备一次沿舷慢行的次序。
cooperation_projects.PlayerRole: 提供真实吃水与受力观察，之后自己沿舷行动，不借走对方私物。
cooperation_projects.PartnerRole: 运用已有舟楫水战知识指出本次借力和退身次序，自付技能内力，不代替主角涉险。

lanchuan-a01.title: The Ferryman's Old Umbrella
lanchuan-a01.brief: Under the eaves of the old thatched hut at Tidewatch Ferry, an oiled-paper umbrella with two broken bamboo ribs hangs tilted year-round, its handle bearing a faint, carved character "Qing". If curious wayfarers ask about it, Song Laolu merely taps his tobacco pipe against a wooden piling: "It's hung there for nineteen years. Only when someone comes to fetch it can this old man close his eyes in peace."

objectives.lanchuan-a01.resolve: Choose how to handle this affair and accept the consequences.

lanchuan-a01.c1.title: Travel downriver to Embroidery Lane in Qinghe City to find Song Qing, telling her the truth of her aging father keeping solitary vigil at the ferry
lanchuan-a01.c1.description: Travel downriver to Embroidery Lane in Qinghe City to find Song Qing, telling her the truth of her aging father keeping solitary vigil at the ferry
lanchuan-a01.c1.success: Song Qing hears her father's news and hands you a bundle of padded cloth.
lanchuan-a01.c1.failure: The attempt does not succeed. The time and supplies already committed are spent; further preparation is needed.
lanchuan-a01.c1.success_echo: Song Qing considers writing to her father; no reconciliation has happened yet.
lanchuan-a01.c1.failure_echo: The earlier attempt remains unresolved. New evidence or better preparation may support another approach.

lanchuan-a01.c2.title: Collect the padded cloth from Song Qing for delivery to her father.
lanchuan-a01.c2.description: Collect the padded cloth from Song Qing for delivery to her father.
lanchuan-a01.c2.success: Song Qing entrusts you with the cloth. It has not yet reached her father.
lanchuan-a01.c2.failure: The attempt does not succeed. The time and supplies already committed are spent; further preparation is needed.
lanchuan-a01.c2.success_echo: The cloth still needs delivering. Song Qing's message remains yours to pass on.
lanchuan-a01.c2.failure_echo: The earlier attempt remains unresolved. New evidence or better preparation may support another approach.

lanchuan-a01.c3.title: Steer clear of past rights and wrongs, simply keeping the old man company on the gangplank on a stormy night over a pipe of dry tobacco, listening to him recount the tides of nineteen years ago three times over.
lanchuan-a01.c3.description: Steer clear of past rights and wrongs, simply keeping the old man company on the gangplank on a stormy night over a pipe of dry tobacco, listening to him recount the tides of nineteen years ago three times over.
lanchuan-a01.c3.success: The ferryman finishes his story and gives you the old inscribed umbrella.
lanchuan-a01.c3.failure: The attempt does not succeed. The time and supplies already committed are spent; further preparation is needed.
lanchuan-a01.c3.success_echo: The umbrella no longer hangs under the eaves. The ferryman welcomes another conversation.
lanchuan-a01.c3.failure_echo: The earlier attempt remains unresolved. New evidence or better preparation may support another approach.

lanchuan-a02.title: Dispute on the Mudflats
lanchuan-a02.brief: At the entrance to Egret Fishing Village, Lan Ali stands with water-parting bone knives in hand, glaring in confrontation against seven or eight blade-wielding salt guards from Azure Salt Flats. Several deep tidal channels where ancestors cast their nets have all been staked off with black wooden pilings by the Salt Gang.

objectives.lanchuan-a02.resolve: Choose how to handle this affair and accept the consequences.

lanchuan-a02.c1.title: Commercial Mediation: Rely on your standing with Fan Shouzhuo or Su Xiaoman of the Azure Cowrie Guild to have the money house subsidize the price difference, striking a compromise over the boundary lines
lanchuan-a02.c1.description: Commercial Mediation: Rely on your standing with Fan Shouzhuo or Su Xiaoman of the Azure Cowrie Guild to have the money house subsidize the price difference, striking a compromise over the boundary lines
lanchuan-a02.c1.success: The guild funds a compromise and both sides step back from the disputed shore.
lanchuan-a02.c1.failure: The attempt does not succeed. The time and supplies already committed are spent; further preparation is needed.
lanchuan-a02.c1.success_echo: Both communities observe the new boundary, though resentment remains.
lanchuan-a02.c1.failure_echo: The earlier attempt remains unresolved. New evidence or better preparation may support another approach.
lanchuan-a02.c1.success_reaction: I checked the boundary stones after the tide and spoke with the people who cast their nets. You let both sides speak, so I am willing to review this boundary payment with you. I do not speak for the salt workers or the money house.
lanchuan-a02.c1.failure_reaction: That attempt did not work. I will not credit a result that never happened. Another discussion needs better preparation; you may also leave it for now.

lanchuan-a02.c2.title: Chart New Flats: Follow the exceptionally skilled diver Lan Ali into the offshore Black Reefs to scout an entirely new trench sheltered from the wind for casting nets, though clearing hidden boulders together will be required
lanchuan-a02.c2.description: Chart New Flats: Follow the exceptionally skilled diver Lan Ali into the offshore Black Reefs to scout an entirely new trench sheltered from the wind for casting nets, though clearing hidden boulders together will be required
lanchuan-a02.c2.success: You and Lan Ali clear the reef channel, opening another fishing ground.
lanchuan-a02.c2.failure: The attempt does not succeed. The time and supplies already committed are spent; further preparation is needed.
lanchuan-a02.c2.success_echo: Fishing boats begin using the cleared channel; Lan Ali wants to check the reef markers.
lanchuan-a02.c2.failure_echo: The earlier attempt remains unresolved. New evidence or better preparation may support another approach.
lanchuan-a02.c2.success_reaction: We have tested the new channel, though its current still needs care. You helped open another livelihood. I will discuss marking the reef with you; each person still decides whether to dive again.
lanchuan-a02.c2.failure_reaction: That attempt did not work. I will not credit a result that never happened. Another discussion needs better preparation; you may also leave it for now.

lanchuan-a02.c3.title: Forceful Suppression: Side with the fishermen to fight tooth and nail on the mudflats to beat back the salt guards, an act that will directly enrage Gu Huaiyuan (triggering early combat with formidable foe B1).
lanchuan-a02.c3.description: Forceful Suppression: Side with the fishermen to fight tooth and nail on the mudflats to beat back the salt guards, an act that will directly enrage Gu Huaiyuan (triggering early combat with formidable foe B1).
lanchuan-a02.c3.success: The salt guards retreat and the fishermen recover the disputed shore.
lanchuan-a02.c3.failure: The attempt does not succeed. The time and supplies already committed are spent; further preparation is needed.
lanchuan-a02.c3.success_echo: The Salt Gang learns of its defeat and prepares for further trouble.
lanchuan-a02.c3.failure_echo: The earlier attempt remains unresolved. New evidence or better preparation may support another approach.
lanchuan-a02.c3.success_reaction: The salt guards were driven off, but injuries and resentment remain. I remember your help, yet I will not repay it by promising another fight. I will discuss the injured people and the boundary stakes.
lanchuan-a02.c3.failure_reaction: That attempt did not work. I will not credit a result that never happened. Another discussion needs better preparation; you may also leave it for now.

lanchuan-a03.title: Three Missing Bags of Salt
lanchuan-a03.brief: A scene of chaos erupts outside the shed at Azure Salt Flats. Little Liu, a young salt worker, kneels weeping on the ground while the overseer bellows: "Three sacks of top-grade azure salt are unaccounted for in the warehouse! If the tally isn't clear by tonight, you'll take twenty lashes and be cast off the flats!"

objectives.lanchuan-a03.resolve: Choose how to handle this affair and accept the consequences.

lanchuan-a03.c1.title: Investigate the Mudflats: Ask Lan Ali for guidance on low tide timing, dredging the deep mud pit to recover shredded burlap fragments rotted by brine, bringing the truth to light
lanchuan-a03.c1.description: Investigate the Mudflats: Ask Lan Ali for guidance on low tide timing, dredging the deep mud pit to recover shredded burlap fragments rotted by brine, bringing the truth to light
lanchuan-a03.c1.success: The damaged salt sack proves an accident, sparing Xiao Liu a whipping.
lanchuan-a03.c1.failure: The attempt does not succeed. The time and supplies already committed are spent; further preparation is needed.
lanchuan-a03.c1.success_echo: Xiao Liu resumes work and the accusation against the fishing village fades.
lanchuan-a03.c1.failure_echo: The earlier attempt remains unresolved. New evidence or better preparation may support another approach.

lanchuan-a03.c2.title: Private Restitution: Cover the deficit secretly out of your own pocket with three taels of broken silver, sparing Little Liu the whipping
lanchuan-a03.c2.description: Private Restitution: Cover the deficit secretly out of your own pocket with three taels of broken silver, sparing Little Liu the whipping
lanchuan-a03.c2.success: Your payment closes the warehouse shortfall and spares Xiao Liu a beating.
lanchuan-a03.c2.failure: The attempt does not succeed. The time and supplies already committed are spent; further preparation is needed.
lanchuan-a03.c2.success_echo: Xiao Liu remembers who helped him and stops to greet you.
lanchuan-a03.c2.failure_echo: The earlier attempt remains unresolved. New evidence or better preparation may support another approach.

lanchuan-a03.c3.title: Report Honestly: Disclose the actual situation privately to Gu Huaiyuan. Gu Huaiyuan maintains strict discipline but respects honest men; he will waive Little Liu's banishment, sentencing him instead to carry mud for half a month.
lanchuan-a03.c3.description: Report Honestly: Disclose the actual situation privately to Gu Huaiyuan. Gu Huaiyuan maintains strict discipline but respects honest men; he will waive Little Liu's banishment, sentencing him instead to carry mud for half a month.
lanchuan-a03.c3.success: Gu Huaiyuan accepts the truthful account and assigns work instead of expulsion and a beating.
lanchuan-a03.c3.failure: The attempt does not succeed. The time and supplies already committed are spent; further preparation is needed.
lanchuan-a03.c3.success_echo: Gu Huaiyuan's work sentence is underway; Xiao Liu keeps his livelihood.
lanchuan-a03.c3.failure_echo: The earlier attempt remains unresolved. New evidence or better preparation may support another approach.

lanchuan-a04.title: Three Days on the Arena Stage
lanchuan-a04.brief: A towering arena stage has been raised before the grand docks of Lankou City. A bold placard on red cloth reads plainly: "Iron-Arm Xie of the Shandong External-Style Iron Arm Sect holds the arena for three days, testing martial masters of the world, wounds and deaths notwithstanding!"

objectives.lanchuan-a04.resolve: Choose how to handle this affair and accept the consequences.

lanchuan-a04.c1.title: Take the Stage Yourself: Leap onto the stage to counter Xie's three sequences of Monument-Smashing Iron-Arm Fist, subduing him with measured restraint
lanchuan-a04.c1.description: Take the Stage Yourself: Leap onto the stage to counter Xie's three sequences of Monument-Smashing Iron-Arm Fist, subduing him with measured restraint
lanchuan-a04.c1.success: Xie Tiebi is driven from the platform; the martial hall honors its promised payment.
lanchuan-a04.c1.failure: The attempt does not succeed. The time and supplies already committed are spent; further preparation is needed.
lanchuan-a04.c1.success_echo: The martial hall discusses the bout and invites you to return.
lanchuan-a04.c1.failure_echo: The earlier attempt remains unresolved. New evidence or better preparation may support another approach.

lanchuan-a04.c2.title: Defuse It Offstage: Secretly uncover the banknotes showing he was bought out by the Eldest Grand Protector of Mount Song, confronting him openly in a restaurant and urging him to retreat in the face of exposure
lanchuan-a04.c2.description: Defuse It Offstage: Secretly uncover the banknotes showing he was bought out by the Eldest Grand Protector of Mount Song, confronting him openly in a restaurant and urging him to retreat in the face of exposure
lanchuan-a04.c2.success: The bribery evidence forces Xie Tiebi to withdraw his challenge.
lanchuan-a04.c2.failure: The attempt does not succeed. The time and supplies already committed are spent; further preparation is needed.
lanchuan-a04.c2.success_echo: The arena is dismantled; Guan Shanhai respects the bloodless settlement.
lanchuan-a04.c2.failure_echo: The earlier attempt remains unresolved. New evidence or better preparation may support another approach.

lanchuan-a04.c3.title: Train Your Martial Kin: Remain in the martial hall to break down the elbow vulnerability of the Monument-Smashing Fist for Zheng Tieniu, allowing Zheng Tieniu to personally mount the stage three days later and seize the laurel.
lanchuan-a04.c3.description: Train Your Martial Kin: Remain in the martial hall to break down the elbow vulnerability of the Monument-Smashing Fist for Zheng Tieniu, allowing Zheng Tieniu to personally mount the stage three days later and seize the laurel.
lanchuan-a04.c3.success: Zheng Tieniu uses the weakness you explained and wins the challenge.
lanchuan-a04.c3.failure: The attempt does not succeed. The time and supplies already committed are spent; further preparation is needed.
lanchuan-a04.c3.success_echo: Zheng Tieniu reviews the weakness with his fellow students.
lanchuan-a04.c3.failure_echo: The earlier attempt remains unresolved. New evidence or better preparation may support another approach.

lanchuan-a05.title: A Crate of Celadon
lanchuan-a05.brief: Taverns across Hedu Town buzz with rumors that the Wild Goose Escort Agency smashed the palace celadon they were hired to protect into pieces. Yet in the back hall, Chief Escort Huo Qianli has accepted a secret, urgent consignment bearing a red wax seal: transport the truly undamaged replacement imperial porcelain to Qinghe City in the Huai-Yangtze region within twelve days without fail.

objectives.lanchuan-a05.resolve: Choose how to handle this affair and accept the consequences.

lanchuan-a05.c1.title: Reconcile the overland cargo documents in Qinghe and complete the handover.
lanchuan-a05.c1.description: Reconcile the overland cargo documents in Qinghe and complete the handover.
lanchuan-a05.c1.success: The porcelain merchant verifies the overland documents and pays the agreed delivery fee.
lanchuan-a05.c1.failure: The attempt does not succeed. The time and supplies already committed are spent; further preparation is needed.
lanchuan-a05.c1.success_echo: The delivered cargo is entered in the merchant's accounts; the escort agency remembers your work.
lanchuan-a05.c1.failure_echo: The earlier attempt remains unresolved. New evidence or better preparation may support another approach.

lanchuan-a05.c2.title: After arriving by river, verify the cargo and seals with the Qinghe merchant.
lanchuan-a05.c2.description: After arriving by river, verify the cargo and seals with the Qinghe merchant.
lanchuan-a05.c2.success: The merchant verifies the river cargo and seals, signs the receipt and pays.
lanchuan-a05.c2.failure: The attempt does not succeed. The time and supplies already committed are spent; further preparation is needed.
lanchuan-a05.c2.success_echo: River merchants hear that the delivery was honored.
lanchuan-a05.c2.failure_echo: The earlier attempt remains unresolved. New evidence or better preparation may support another approach.

lanchuan-a05.c3.title: Reconcile the divided escort records with Yan Xiaowu and complete the handover.
lanchuan-a05.c3.description: Reconcile the divided escort records with Yan Xiaowu and complete the handover.
lanchuan-a05.c3.success: You and Yan Xiaowu reconcile the divided escort records; the merchant signs and pays.
lanchuan-a05.c3.failure: The attempt does not succeed. The time and supplies already committed are spent; further preparation is needed.
lanchuan-a05.c3.success_echo: Yan Xiaowu and Huo Qianli recognize your part in the divided escort.
lanchuan-a05.c3.failure_echo: The earlier attempt remains unresolved. New evidence or better preparation may support another approach.

lanchuan-a06.title: The Steersmen's Feud
lanchuan-a06.brief: Outside the Loyalty Hall of Duckweed Dock Water Stronghold on Lake Qingping, boatmen young and old gather in a crowd. Young Steersman Ge Qing stands at the prow clutching an iron boat pole, reading new bylaws aloud, while Old Steersman Ge Changgao sits inside the cabin, slamming his dry pipe against the timber, both sides arguing red in the face.

objectives.lanchuan-a06.resolve: Choose how to handle this affair and accept the consequences.

lanchuan-a06.c1.title: Trial Compromise: Propose a middle ground of "testing the scheme on three tributaries for one season", with merchant vessels backed by Xiang Danian of Master Liu's lineage under the Mount Heng Sect standing surety against risks
lanchuan-a06.c1.description: Trial Compromise: Propose a middle ground of "testing the scheme on three tributaries for one season", with merchant vessels backed by Xiang Danian of Master Liu's lineage under the Mount Heng Sect standing surety against risks
lanchuan-a06.c1.success: The boatmen agree to a trial on three tributaries; Ge Qing gives you a boat whistle.
lanchuan-a06.c1.failure: The attempt does not succeed. The time and supplies already committed are spent; further preparation is needed.
lanchuan-a06.c1.success_echo: The tributary trial opens a different river route.
lanchuan-a06.c1.failure_echo: The earlier attempt remains unresolved. New evidence or better preparation may support another approach.

lanchuan-a06.c2.title: Uphold the Old Ways: Help the old steersman inspect the flaws of small skiffs in braving heavy waves and repelling river bandits, advising Ge Qing to postpone the rollout
lanchuan-a06.c2.description: Uphold the Old Ways: Help the old steersman inspect the flaws of small skiffs in braving heavy waves and repelling river bandits, advising Ge Qing to postpone the rollout
lanchuan-a06.c2.success: Ge Qing agrees to delay the proposal; the established convoy policy remains.
lanchuan-a06.c2.failure: The attempt does not succeed. The time and supplies already committed are spent; further preparation is needed.
lanchuan-a06.c2.success_echo: The old consolidated convoy policy continues.
lanchuan-a06.c2.failure_echo: The earlier attempt remains unresolved. New evidence or better preparation may support another approach.

lanchuan-a06.c3.title: Call External Aid: Partner with Huo Qianli of the Wild Goose Escort Agency, having escort guards board the small craft to cover the defensive shortcomings of independent boatmen.
lanchuan-a06.c3.description: Call External Aid: Partner with Huo Qianli of the Wild Goose Escort Agency, having escort guards board the small craft to cover the defensive shortcomings of independent boatmen.
lanchuan-a06.c3.success: The escort agency and boatmen agree to cooperate; Ge Qing gives you a boat whistle.
lanchuan-a06.c3.failure: The attempt does not succeed. The time and supplies already committed are spent; further preparation is needed.
lanchuan-a06.c3.success_echo: Small boats and escort banners begin using the tributaries together.
lanchuan-a06.c3.failure_echo: The earlier attempt remains unresolved. New evidence or better preparation may support another approach.

lanchuan-a07.title: The Non-Paying Guest
lanchuan-a07.brief: Beside the hearth at Three Willows Inn, Auntie Zhong chops pork ribs while cursing loudly: "That down-and-out painter in the tattered robe! Living and eating off me for three whole months, painting that blasted lake water every single day, owing me four taels and seven qian of silver!"

objectives.lanchuan-a07.resolve: Choose how to handle this affair and accept the consequences.

lanchuan-a07.c1.title: Seek Malachite Azurite: Head to the Cangwu Ridge herbal market to search for the rare natural mineral "peacock stone green" required to paint sublime mist, helping him complete the scroll
lanchuan-a07.c1.description: Seek Malachite Azurite: Head to the Cangwu Ridge herbal market to search for the rare natural mineral "peacock stone green" required to paint sublime mist, helping him complete the scroll
lanchuan-a07.c1.success: The pigment lets Shi Bugui finish his painting; he gives you the lake chart.
lanchuan-a07.c1.failure: The attempt does not succeed. The time and supplies already committed are spent; further preparation is needed.
lanchuan-a07.c1.success_echo: The painting dries and the inn dispute subsides.
lanchuan-a07.c1.failure_echo: The earlier attempt remains unresolved. New evidence or better preparation may support another approach.

lanchuan-a07.c2.title: Pay His Tab: Settle the four taels and seven qian out of your own pouch; deeply ashamed, Shi Bugui presents his personal self-defense dagger in return

lanchuan-q01.title: Severed Palms: The Broken Eighteen Dragon-Subduing Palms and the Sealed Stances Case
lanchuan-q01.brief: The Eighteen Dragon-Subduing Palms, the supreme martial art of the Beggars' Sect—the realm's greatest faction—has only been passed down through its first twelve stances across generations in the Lanchuan martial world. Where the final six stances vanished remains a subject of endless dispute. Some claim they were lost during the Song-Jin wars; others say their unyielding fury defied heaven and invited divine retribution; still, old beggars mutter in drunken stupors that the old sect master himself swore an oath and sealed them away in the deep mountains.

objectives.lanchuan-q01.stage1: Markings on the Caokou Fair Bowl (A10): The hidden half-dragon-scale palm-flipping pattern carved into the bottom of the old beggar's clay bowl.
objectives.lanchuan-q01.stage2: Marginalia in Ji Wenmo's Old Manuscript (A12): Small regular script notes beside the Shaolin workshop's old scroll: "Proud dragon repents, fullness cannot last; should it reach the wild battle, blood stains the azure sky." The calligraphy matches the carvings on the brushwood gate at Heart-Cleansing Ravine down to every stroke.
objectives.lanchuan-q01.stage3: Severed Palm Print at Old Locust Dock: Palm impressions three inches deep on the headquarters' training boulder that terminate abruptly at the twelfth stance, with dark-red bloodstains preserved in the rock fissures from Qi Wujiu violently reining in his internal force.
objectives.lanchuan-q01.stage4: Niu Bushi's Breakdown: If presented with the clay bowl and the manuscript, stubborn Elder Niu breaks down in tears, revealing three loose pages of remnant mental methods (I43) kept because "the old sect master wished to protect future generations from being consumed by demonic force."
objectives.lanchuan-q01.stage5: Trial of Heart with the Ravine Woodcutter: Bring the rubbing, old bowl, and manuscript to meet Old Woodcutter Tao. The old man sighs deeply, finally tracing out the true energetic pivots of the final six stances on the sand.
objectives.lanchuan-q01.ending: Decide how to conclude this affair.

lanchuan-q02.title: "Tale of the Seven Friends" — The Double Ninth Night Nineteen Years Ago and the Sunken Ship Chang Geng
lanchuan-q02.brief: Nineteen years ago (the fourth year of Ninghe), on the night of the Double Ninth Festival (the ninth day of the ninth lunar month), an earth-shattering tragedy struck Mist-Wave Manor in the heart of Qingping Lake. The "Seven Friends of Lanchuan," who once shared deep bonds and took martial oaths as sworn brothers, shattered and went their separate ways that very night. One perished in a sea of flames, while the rest scattered into the miasmal wastes of the northern frontiers; for twenty years, none have dared speak a single word of those events in front of others.

lanchuan-q03.title: "Lantern of the Returning Sail" — Lighting a Lamp for Yourself in the Humble Jianghu
lanchuan-q03.brief: Wandering through the jianghu for decades, where does my soul find rest? No matter how illustrious the disciples of renowned sects become, what they strive for is but the pedigree of masters and elders. A true warrior must ultimately carve out a sanctuary in the mud-and-water market towns across the land—a place to shelter from wind and rain, where destitute brothers can step inside to drink a bowl of hot soup. A single roof, a bond of good faith, and a family craft make for an ever-burning "Lantern of the Returning Sail."

objectives.lanchuan-q03.stage1: A House (Root of Survival): Secure one of six available ruined urban properties—South Bank "Returning Sail Inn" at Tidewatch Ferry, a vacant lakeside bamboo stilt-house in Lingge Village, an old oil press on Shaolin Front Street, a disused tea warehouse in Sangma Town, a deserted tea stall in Yingxian Town at Mount Taihe, or an abandoned stone hut at the iron-chain bridge of Cangwu Ridge.
objectives.lanchuan-q03.stage2: Good Faith (Reputation and Oaths): Resolve at least three local public livelihood crises (Category A affairs) to earn personal endorsement letters from local elders (such as Song Laolu, Aunt Zhong, Tu Dahu, Lei Baishan), establishing upright repute across prefectural archives and greenwood circles alike.
objectives.lanchuan-q03.stage3: A Trade (A Calling and Craft): Hang a shingle outside the door dedicated to an acquired trade or intermediate-or-higher martial art (medicine, blacksmithing, boatmanship, Tai Chi Quan, Five Mountains Swordplay), practicing medicine to heal the world or escorting lone wayfarers.
objectives.lanchuan-q03.stage4: A Brotherhood (Uniting the Four Seas): Amidst realm-wide turmoil, stalwarts of the jianghu who once received great kindness from the player (such as the destitute painter Shi Bugui, tea-picker maiden Qu Aqiao, escort youth Yan Xiaowu, herbalist apprentice A'Ling, divine beggar Pu Xiaoqi) come to offer allegiance, forming an independent market-town alliance unbound by major sects.

lanchuan-a02-echo-1.title: The Boundary and Its Remaining Accounts
lanchuan-a02-echo-1.brief: After checking the mediated boundary, Lan Ali will compare the payments received and the remaining disagreement. Mediation did not erase every difference.

objectives.lanchuan-a02-echo-1.work: Check this one subsidy with its recipients

lanchuan-a02-echo-1.work.title: Check this one subsidy with its recipients
lanchuan-a02-echo-1.work.description: Compare actual payments in White-Egret Village without opening unrelated private accounts.
lanchuan-a02-echo-1.work.success: Recipients and unpaid amounts are separated. A stake-moving fee had been counted as a subsidy; the source is now clear. Any further payment still requires agreement.
lanchuan-a02-echo-1.work.failure: Accounts conflict. Both statements are retained without fabricating signatures.
lanchuan-a02-echo-1.work.success_echo: This discrepancy now has a specific source instead of becoming a rumor that the whole village was cheated. Further negotiation is optional.
lanchuan-a02-echo-1.work.failure_echo: The known gap still needs checking. Improve preparation or leave it for now; it creates no invented reward or pursuit.

lanchuan-a02-echo-2.title: Marking the New Channel's Backflow
lanchuan-a02-echo-2.brief: After several trial catches, Lan Ali confirms the channel is usable but a backflow drags shallow boats off line. She will discuss visible markers.

objectives.lanchuan-a02-echo-2.work: Mark the backflow from two shore points

lanchuan-a02-echo-2.work.title: Mark the backflow from two shore points
lanchuan-a02-echo-2.work.description: Use actual boating skill to place two visible marks beside the opened channel. Do not move the same boulder or claim the old gift again.
lanchuan-a02-echo-2.work.success: The marks remain visible at low water. Boats can test the channel, but rough weather still calls for stopping.
lanchuan-a02-echo-2.work.failure: The backflow prevents stable placement. A warning to suspend passage is all that can be established.
lanchuan-a02-echo-2.work.success_echo: The two marks remain recognizable. Weather still governs use; the channel does not guarantee endless catches.
lanchuan-a02-echo-2.work.failure_echo: The known gap still needs checking. Improve preparation or leave it for now; it creates no invented reward or pursuit.

lanchuan-a02-failure.title: Establishing the Old Tide Line
lanchuan-a02-failure.brief: After failed mediation, Lan Ali will start from a verifiable tide line. She asks for neither a guarantee on behalf of the money house nor a promise of reconciliation.

objectives.lanchuan-a02-failure.work: Compare stake bases and the low-water line

lanchuan-a02-failure.work.title: Compare stake bases and the low-water line
lanchuan-a02-failure.work.description: Distinguish observations from villagers' accounts while examining the old stakes.
lanchuan-a02-failure.work.success: Not every stake was moved overnight. One fell in a rotten socket; two others show fresh digging. The dispute now has specific questions.
lanchuan-a02-failure.work.failure: Water still hides the difference between old sockets and fresh holes. Neither side's full account is confirmed.
lanchuan-a02-failure.work.success_echo: The fresh holes can be questioned or the fallen stake repaired. An inspection is not a new agreement between the parties.
lanchuan-a02-failure.work.failure_echo: The known gap still needs checking. Improve preparation or leave it for now; it creates no invented reward or pursuit.

lanchuan-tide-lamp.title: The Lamp Ahead of the Tide
lanchuan-tide-lamp.brief: Boatmen find Tidewatch Cliff's lamp appears before safe low water. Compare shore traces with the keeper's timing before deciding how to handle this discrepancy.

objectives.lanchuan-tide-lamp.shore: Establish the current tide line at the salt flats.
objectives.lanchuan-tide-lamp.clock: Check the keeper's timer and physical traces at Tidewatch Cliff.
objectives.lanchuan-tide-lamp.resolve: Correct the signal or leave a safe detour notice at the cliff.

lanchuan-tide-lamp.survey.title: Measure the water with your rope
lanchuan-tide-lamp.survey.description: Use learned boating skill and a hooked rope, spending 6 inner energy.
lanchuan-tide-lamp.survey.success: A side current remains after water passes the old mark. Two clear mud-line marks establish the comparison.
lanchuan-tide-lamp.survey.failure: The current keeps the rope unstable; this does not establish safe night passage.
lanchuan-tide-lamp.survey.success_echo: These two traces support this comparison, not a permanent seasonal prediction.
lanchuan-tide-lamp.survey.failure_echo: Preparation is still needed; spent time remains real.

lanchuan-tide-lamp.watch.title: Pay for a guided tide watch
lanchuan-tide-lamp.watch.description: Pay 80 copper for a boatman's explanation and observe from shore for three hours. This buys one guided observation, not boating mastery.
lanchuan-tide-lamp.watch.success: You see the old line exposed before the reef approach is safe. The complaint now has observable evidence.
lanchuan-tide-lamp.watch.failure: Breaking waves hide the necessary mark; no reliable comparison is established.
lanchuan-tide-lamp.watch.success_echo: The guided watch is paid once and does not refresh its record or reward.
lanchuan-tide-lamp.watch.failure_echo: Preparation is still needed; spent time and fees remain real.

lanchuan-tide-lamp.compare.title: Compare the water clock and tide board
lanchuan-tide-lamp.compare.description: At the cliff, compare your shore record with the keeper's clock, plug and handover marks.
lanchuan-tide-lamp.compare.success: The replacement plug leaks too quickly while the keeper uses the old scale. Tide traces, flow and handover date agree: this fault is not deliberate wrecking.
lanchuan-tide-lamp.compare.failure: The handover record is missing and the clock has not been measured long enough. Suspicion is not proof.
lanchuan-tide-lamp.compare.success_echo: The answer explains this lamp's timing, not every harbor rumor.
lanchuan-tide-lamp.compare.failure_echo: Preparation is still needed; spent time remains real.

lanchuan-tide-lamp.repair.title: Repair the plug and recalibrate
lanchuan-tide-lamp.repair.description: Use one forging-iron unit and learned weapon-repair skill, spending 6 inner energy, to repair this lamp's timer.
lanchuan-tide-lamp.repair.success: The repaired timer matches this measured tide. The keeper accepts the calibration record, not a promise of eternal accuracy.
lanchuan-tide-lamp.repair.failure: The plug still leaks. Used material is gone; a warning against night passage remains.
lanchuan-tide-lamp.repair.success_echo: The repair and calibration have a traceable record. This is not a refreshed mystery.
lanchuan-tide-lamp.repair.failure_echo: Preparation is still needed; time and used material remain spent.

lanchuan-tide-lamp.mark.title: Leave a warning and a known shoreline detour
lanchuan-tide-lamp.mark.description: Pay 40 copper for the keeper's sign materials. State the verified error without dismantling the timer or claiming it repaired.
lanchuan-tide-lamp.mark.success: The sign explains the early lamp and side current. Arrivals may choose the daytime shore route; the keeper still has a timer to repair.
lanchuan-tide-lamp.mark.failure: The sign cannot be secured, so its warning has not reached arriving boats.
lanchuan-tide-lamp.mark.success_echo: Notice and a detour settle your part. You receive no repair payment and need not pursue it further.
lanchuan-tide-lamp.mark.failure_echo: Preparation is still needed; time and fees remain spent.

quest.canglang_member_ferry_visit.title: Learn the Route to Hedu Town
quest.canglang_member_ferry_visit.brief: Ge Changgao asks a formal Surging Wave Boat Gang member to travel from Duckweed Anchorage to Hedu Town and learn this route. The agreement covers arrival only, not a completed safety inspection or a guarantee on anyone’s behalf.

objectives.quest.canglang_member_ferry_visit.visit: After accepting, personally arrive at Hedu Town.

story.narrative_requirements: 先写眼前的生活与人物行动，让玩家决定是否承接事务。公开介绍与作者秘密分别使用；秘密只在取得证据后揭示。人物按所在地域、日常与接触门槛登场。原稿能力是传承说明，当前结果以已登记规则和实际结算为准，不凭正文凭空发钱、发物或授予能力。

origins.name: 渡口来客
origins.description: 曾在海船与水路间讨生活的行路人。懂些水性与粗浅把式，见惯了码头风浪，随身带着旧信与行囊，初涉澜川水陆江湖。

origins.name: 一碗镖饭
origins.description: 在车马尘土中历练出来的镖行好手。通晓号令切口与牲口脾性，使一口沉稳雁翎刀，凭一身真力气在江湖道上吃安稳饭。

origins.name: 半卷道书
origins.description: 在名山别院研读静修的游方学子。略通吐纳调息与入门拳架，奉命下山历练红尘烟火，进退去留皆由己心。

origins.name: 武林世家少主
origins.description: 你是澜川一户武林名门的嫡系继承人，自幼由家中高手亲授刀剑，已能独当一面。随身有三千两银钱、青钢长剑和护身装备。家中在澜口城的宅院为你敞着门，出门见客不必再从杂役做起。

origins.name: 重出江湖的镖师
origins.description: 早年走过水陆两道，如今旧伤已愈，刀法也还在。六百五十两积蓄压在箱底，当年欠你一个人情的船家已经到了门口。

origins.name: 自定义出身
origins.description: 来处、身份和这一趟的缘由，由你自己写。

affiliations.name: 随出身
affiliations.description: 沿用所选出身已有的归属与人际。

locations.name: 随出身起点
locations.description: 从所选出身的地点开始。

adventure_weapons.name: 短刀
adventure_weapons.description: 扎实劈斩，攻势直接。 开局实际装备对应练习兵器，后续可换学。

adventure_weapons.name: 长剑
adventure_weapons.description: 以短促剑势兼顾回护，护御只抵消列明的少量来势。 开局实际装备对应练习兵器，后续可换学。

adventure_weapons.name: 齐眉棍
adventure_weapons.description: 借棍梢牵制一次身位，气力开销较高，不能连续锁住对手。 开局实际装备对应练习兵器，后续可换学。

adventure_weapons.name: 长枪
adventure_weapons.description: 直线进枪威力较高，腿脚受封或雾障阻路时不能强行突进。 开局实际装备对应练习兵器，后续可换学。

adventure_weapons.name: 拳脚
adventure_weapons.description: 近身拳脚留有回护余地，短护掌不是名器，也不能隔空伤人。 开局实际装备对应练习兵器，后续可换学。

adventure_methods.name: 调养吐纳
adventure_methods.description: 缓慢调息补回少量气力与体力，需让出这一轮攻击。 这是自制入门路数，不预授名门绝学。

adventure_methods.name: 沉桩护体
adventure_methods.description: 以沉稳桩势承接冲击，擅守而不同时出招。 这是自制入门路数，不预授名门绝学。

adventure_methods.name: 短息催劲
adventure_methods.description: 短促催动一次猛击，每次自损生命上限的4%并积累1点伤势；须量力而用。 这是自制入门路数，不预授名门绝学。
